name: PT Supreme Cable Manufacturing & Commerce Tbk
summary: PT Supreme Cable Manufacturing & Commerce Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cables, insulation, cable-related products and raw materials, and melamine products in Indonesia and internationally. The company offers high voltage power cables; medium voltage cable that include armour and non armour cables, lead sheath cables, and spacer cables; low voltage power cables, such as PVC insulated and AL PVC/XLPE insulated cables; building wires; flexible and instrumental cables; and solar cables.
